steps.text: Click on (+) at the bottom right corner
Enter beneficiary details –> next  /n a. Enter IABN/ account number  /n b. Enter beneficiary name. /n c. Enter beneficiary nickname.  /n d. Enter beneficiary address
In review screen, all details entered will be reviewed with the possibility of: /n a. Go back and edit details.   /n b. Add profile image for beneficiary.  /n c. Confirm.
